title: 第2791章 政变再变第2790章 变天之祸
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
三人摒弃其他人，进入那个别院中。
此时，孔丽，元冰冰，朴慧三人刚手忙脚乱为那位侍女换好药。
亏得有赵宇留给她们的那些灵丹妙药，这位原本受伤极重的女子，终于保住了性命。
一见三人入内，孔丽忙起身对轩辕封三人行了一礼，而元冰冰和朴慧见之，也忙起身行礼。
“在下孔丽见过轩辕少阁主，宣公主，蕾公主。”
“见过少阁主，两位公主。”
元冰冰与朴慧却不认得轩辕封和灵蕾，所以只好跟随孔丽行礼道。
一见轩辕封亲临，孔丽心中甚感震动。
论境界，轩辕封可甩她十条街，论身份地位，两人同样不可同日而语。
“喂喂，这是作甚？我们可是一家人，何须如此重礼？”
一家人？
“别惊讶，你们是我兄弟的家人，自然是我轩辕封的家人。
懊，我兄弟就叫赵宇。”
孔雀皇朝不在仙灵大陆，所以有些信息的传达难免滞后。
再说轩辕封与赵宇的关系，只是私下的兄弟关系，知道之人本就稀少。
说到这，轩辕封又孔丽三人也回了一礼，道：“几位弟妹，这次让你们受委屈了，我轩辕封在此抱歉了。”
弟妹？
不过一听这称呼，这三人反应各异，特别是孔丽，神情有些尴尬。
“那，那见过大哥，见过嫂子，也见过宣姐姐。”
也不管孔丽尴不尴尬，元冰冰一拉孔丽，三人便齐声开口道。

“哎呀，这辈份可别弄乱了，你们才是姐姐，这样称呼不合适。”
听罢自己被称为姐姐，灵宣忙双手乱摇，还一脸的不好意思。
“这些客套都无关紧要，反正一家人团结友爱最重要。”
轩辕封见这几个娘们你推我让，忙摆摆手阻止了。
他又看了看孔丽道：“郡主，不客套，不说虚的。
你们这次是遇到大麻烦了吧？”
“是的，不瞒少阁主，事情确实如此。”
自见到灵宣，又听罢轩辕封与赵宇关系后，孔丽也放下那份悬着的心。
现在见轩辕封问话，也就实话回答。
“那究竟发生了什么事，让你这位郡主也亡命出逃？”
“呃哼，事情是这样的……”
孔丽稳了稳心神，又开口了。
孔雀皇朝往前推三代，有十万年历史。
那一代的皇主当政四万余年，励精图治之下，把一个二流皇朝推到一流势力。
他的生育能力也是不弱，共有十三位子嗣，六男七女。
当时，这位皇主已到九阶之境。
也在这时，他感觉自己的修为难有寸进，而且日见虚弱，似乎大限将近。
content_en:
The three of them abandoned the others and entered the other courtyard.
At this time, Kong Li, Yuan Bingbing, and Pu Hui were busy changing the medicine for the maid.
Thanks to the miraculous medicines that Zhao Yu left for them, this woman who was originally seriously injured finally saved her life.
As soon as she saw the three people entering, Kong Li hurriedly stood up and saluted Xuanyuan Feng and the others. When Yuan Bingbing and Pu Hui saw them, they also hurriedly stood up and saluted.
"Kong Li has met Young Pavilion Master Xuanyuan, Princess Xuan, and Princess Lei."
"I've met the Young Pavilion Master and the two princesses."
Yuan Bingbing and Pu Hui did not recognize Xuanyuan Feng and Linglei, so they had no choice but to follow Kong Li and salute.
Kong Li was deeply shocked when she saw Xuanyuan Feng coming in person.
In terms of realm, Xuanyuan Feng was ten miles ahead of her. In terms of status, the two of them were also different.
"Hey, what are you doing? We are a family, why do we need to be so polite?"
A family?
"Don't be surprised, you are my brother's family, and naturally you are my Xuanyuan Feng's family.
Chao, my brother’s name is Zhao Yu. "
The Peacock Dynasty is not in the Fairy Continent, so the transmission of some information will inevitably be delayed.
Besides, the relationship between Xuanyuan Feng and Zhao Yu is just a private brotherly relationship, and few people know about it.
Speaking of this, Xuanyuan Feng and Kong Li also bowed back and said, "Brothers and sisters, I, Xuanyuan Feng, have made you feel wronged this time. I, Xuanyuan Feng, am here to apologize."
Siblings?
However, upon hearing this title, the three people had different reactions, especially Kong Li, who looked a little embarrassed.
"Well, then I have met my eldest brother, my sister-in-law, and I have also met my sister Xuan."
Regardless of whether Kong Li was embarrassed or not, when Yuan Bingbing pulled Kong Li, the three of them spoke in unison.
"Oh, don't mess up this generation. You are the sisters. It's inappropriate to call them this."
After hearing that she was called sister, Lingxuan hurriedly shook his hands and looked embarrassed.
"These courtesies don't matter. Anyway, unity and friendship as a family are the most important thing."
Xuanyuan Feng saw these girls pushing each other and he quickly waved his hand to stop them.
He looked at Kong Li again and said: "Princess, you are not polite and don't make false remarks.
Are you in big trouble this time? "
"Yes, to be honest with you, Master, this is indeed the case."
After meeting Lingxuan and hearing about the relationship between Xuanyuan Feng and Zhao Yu, Kong Li also let go of her worries.
Now that Xuanyuan Feng was asking questions, he answered truthfully.
"Then what happened that made you, the princess, flee for your life?"
"Uh-huh, here's the thing..."
Kong Li calmed down and spoke again.
The Mauryan Dynasty stretches back three generations and has a history of 100,000 years.
The emperor of that generation had been in power for more than 40,000 years. Through hard work and hard work, he promoted a second-rate dynasty to a first-rate power.
His fertility was not weak either, with a total of thirteen children, six boys and seven girls.
At that time, the emperor had reached the ninth level.
At this time, he felt that it was difficult to make any progress in his cultivation, and he was getting weaker day by day, as if his end was approaching.
